title: Eight Calves Detection Split
description: Private YOLO-format detection split of the 8-Calves dataset (Fang et al., 2025, https://huggingface.co/datasets/tonyFang04/8-calves, CC BY 4.0). Train: 500 hand-labelled frames (am feed 2-3 March, pm feed 1-3 March). Val: 100 frames (am feed 4 March). Frames from the pm feed of 4 March are excluded because the test video comes from that session. Single class: calf.
